prompt: Write a rate_limiter.py implementing a token-bucket rate limiter class TokenBucket, with a blocking acquire(n) and a non-blocking try_acquire(n). It must be fully documented.
assertions: Module has a docstring with a one-line summary and a typical usage example
TokenBucket class docstring includes an Attributes: section documenting public attributes
acquire and try_acquire have docstrings with Args: and Returns: sections; Raises: present where the code raises for invalid input
All docstrings use triple double quotes with descriptive (not imperative) first lines ending in a period
With type annotations present, docstrings describe semantics without repeating the types
try_acquire's Returns: explains the True/False semantics; acquire documents its blocking behavior
Any inline comments are separated from code by at least two spaces and explain intent rather than restating code
Thread-safety behavior is stated in the class or module docstring (either safe or not — just stated)
